title: Comparative effectiveness of triple-headed and conventional toothbrushes for plaque control and gingival health in children and adolescents with autism spectrum disorder
html: Children and adolescents with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) are prone to poor oral hygiene due to motor and sensory challenges. This trial evaluated whether a triple-headed toothbrush (THT) improves gingival health and plaque control more effectively than a conventional toothbrush (CT).
